### Pettitt Test

For more information, see [here](https://rileywheadon.github.io/ffa-docs/eda/#pettitt-test). 

`r params$msg`

Additional information:

- K-statistic: `r round(params$k.statistic, 2)`
- K-statistic significance threshold: `r round(params$k.critical, 2)`
